field_principles.duration_s: Total wall-clock for the hardware-smoke continuity run.
field_principles.gatemate_reachable: Bare bool for GateMate reachability through DirtyJTAG detect.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix naming the observed KV260 overlay/latency gate plus per-board blockers.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Must remain hardware_smoke because this artifact records board smoke, not model inference.
field_principles.kv260_overlay_loaded: principle: the KV260 terminal-state gate -- overlay present is the precondition for a board-latency claim
field_principles.kv260_reachable: Bare bool for KV260 SSH reachability through kria.
field_principles.per_board_duration_s: Distinct positive wall-clock timer per board.
field_principles.per_board_next_step: Bare dict of the next concrete step for each board.
field_principles.per_board_reachability: principle: the continuity record that keeps boards visible in retros
field_principles.per_board_terminal_state: Bare dict of observed terminal-state progress or exact per-board blocker.
field_principles.polarfire_reachable: Bare bool for PolarFire SSH reachability.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: principle: records which board accesses were verified before the smoke, pre-empting the fabricate-when-unreachable failure mode
